text:
kevin: FYI — noticed proxy stalls when doing fallback routing for streaming tails. Saw ~100-250ms holds where the gateway picks fallback. Repro on canary.

maria: what's the triggering signal? model error vs conn failure?

kevin: mostly 503s from backend or long queuing; gateway pauses while it tears down the outbound and sets up new one. logs: ```EDGE: stream pause idx=214 reason=backend_503 wait_ms=173 route=primary->fallback```

sam: do we have a handshake to resume partial KV cache? If we restart outbound we lose cache and regen causes latencies.

olivia: we could try in-place failover: proxy buffers last N tokens and swap backend without closing client stream. Needs duplicate conn and buffer memory.

kevin: current impl is close-and-reopen outbound then relay client — simple but adds a visible pause.

nate: hedging earlier is an option: if backend queue > Xms, spawn fallback connection and race. Works but wastes GPU if primaries recover.

maria: agree hedging cost vs SLO; need a budget.

sam: another idea: proactive degrade mode — when primary shows early signals (queue_depth > threshold) switch to truncated streaming mode that emits lightweight interim frames until final tokens available.

olivia: placeholders are risky for downstream UX.

kevin: alternative: send inline 'degraded' markers so client knows this is a best-effort partial stream, e.g. small JSON token {"_meta":"degraded","partial":true} then continue. Clients would need to handle it.

maria: also need resume/idempotency metadata so clients don't double-render on reconnect.

kevin: quick protocol sketch: ```
// gateway assigns stream_id and resume_offset
client <- gateway: tokens (stream_id=abc, resume_offset=42)
if failover:
  gateway opens new backend with resume_offset=42 so model can prime KV cache
  gateway resumes streaming without closing client
```

sam: priming still costs but bounded by resume_offset; cheaper than full regeneration.

olivia: memory tradeoff: in-place swap needs buffer; what's safe? I'll propose a per-stream cap.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 1977771300 of edge-proxy with fallback metrics enabled :rocket:

kevin: experiment plan: 1) gather pause distribution for close/reopen; 2) run hedging experiment with strict backpressure caps for 24h; 3) prototype in-place swap with 32KB buffer limit.

olivia: mapping memory: 32KB per hot stream looks okay given current connection cardinality; will validate.

maria: instrumentation reqs: record tags: "fallback_reason", "pause_ms", "buffer_bytes", "resume_success". Also surface in per-route dashboard.

kevin: I'll open an RFC (RFC-EDGE-XXXX) with call graph + perf sims + operator knobs. Target: decision in 2 weeks. Assigning eng-architecture.

nate: ping me for cost sims and hedging budget math.

maria: :thumbsup:
